newsitem.title: CHINA: Hun Sen arrives for meeting with Cambodia king.
newsitem.headline: Hun Sen arrives for meeting with Cambodia king.

text.p: Cambodian Second Prime Minister Hun Sen arrived on Tuesday at the Beijing residence of King Norodom Sihanouk to seek the monarch's political blessing for his grab for power last month.
Security was tight in and around the residence as a convoy of six cars carrying Cambodian flags swept inside with Hun Sen and other senior officials.
Hun Sen arrived in Beijing on Monday accompanied by newly-appointed First Prime Minister Ung Huot, acting head of state Chea Sim and a delegation of government officials.

His arrival followed an offer to abdicate by Sihanouk, who has so far declined to endorse Hun Sen's rule, instead criticising Ung Huot as a "puppet" of Hun Sen and likening the current political situation in his country to a "comedy".

Analysts said Hun Sen, who seized sole power after ousting the king's son and co-premier Prince Norodom Ranariddh in a July coup, would try to secure Sihanouk's political blessing to put the final stamp of legitimacy on his takeover.
Sihanouk has said he would meet Hun Sen and co-premier Ung Huot on Tuesday at his residence, but only on a private basis. He has been in Beijing for medical treatment since February.
